summary: Oaktree Gardens OLP, LLC filed an 8-K reporting a Third Amendment to its revolving credit agreement, dated September 21, 2026 and effective September 24, 2026, among the Company as initial borrower, Gardens Coinvest, LLC as qualified borrower, Oaktree Gardens OLP SPV, L.P. as guarantor, the Oaktree general partners, Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation as administrative agent and letter of credit issuer, and the lenders. The amendment extended maturity to September 23, 2027, with options up to September 18, 2031, cut SOFR margins to 1.75% and unused fees to 0.20% above 50% utilization. This is a routine credit-facility modification, not a special situation.
